July has 31 days → back 31 to June 13, 1480 (113-31=82 left).  
June has 30 days → back 30 to May 14, 1480 (82-30=52 left).  
May has 31 days → back 31 to April 13, 1480 (52-31=21 left).  
April has 30 days → back 21 days to March 23, 1480 (21 used, 0 left).
